summary: Link qualified native conversation delivery turns to their fenced Small Talk read receipt

replay.detail: No transcript fold, claim replay or history backfill. Legacy/unqualified receipts remain without a link.

schema.detail: Optional TimelineEntry.delivers behind conversation-delivery-links.v1; authored/generated codecs updated. Adds empty owner-local receipt identity table/indexes at ordinary Store initialization. No replicated claim vocabulary or storage version change.

rules.detail: Existing receipt admission, mailbox/native authority, canonical claim selection, checkpoint and retention rules remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Daemons first. Old/unnegotiated clients receive no new field. The typed owner relay negotiates/preserves it; old generated Rust entry codec ignores the additive field.

downtime.detail: Ordinary daemon update; no extra request-path initialization or deployment operation is assigned.

recovery.detail: Native record identity is persisted with pending handoffs and the successful local read receipt. ACK replay does not rebind it. Claim-only backup/restore does not carry local receipt identity metadata, so the optional link remains unavailable.
